scenes.title: Hello Tl
scenes.sub: your first timeline, in six steps
scenes.text: Hello Tl. Your first timeline, in six steps. A player that teleports along X, from a timeline.

scenes.title: Step 1: install the package

lines.text: Package Manager > + > Install package from git URL

scenes.text: Step one. Install the package. Use the newest Unity seven editor, with a Universal three D project. In the Package Manager, choose install package from git U R L, and paste this address.

scenes.title: Step 2: import the sample
scenes.text: Step two. Import the sample. Open Tl Unity Playback in the Package Manager, and press import next to Hello Tl. Open Teleport dot C S. It is the whole example.

scenes.title: Step 3: read the one file
scenes.text: Step three. Read the one file. First, the clip. It holds the numbers the designer types. Next, the track. It turns a clip into a value, when the clip starts and when it ends. Then the kind, which adds that value to a column. And the column is where the result lives.

scenes.title: Step 4: build the scene

lines.text: builds the timeline, a Player cube in a SubScene, a camera

scenes.text: Step four. Build the scene. Choose Tl Hello, then Build Scene, from the menu. It builds the timeline, a player cube in a sub scene, and a camera, and opens the scene.

scenes.title: Step 5: press Play
scenes.text: Step five. Press play. At tick thirty the player is at five. At tick ninety, at thirteen. At tick one nineteen the clip ends, and it comes back to five. The console prints each change.

scenes.title: Step 6: the same file, without Unity
scenes.text: Step six. The same file runs without Unity. Run the hello demo with dot net, and you get the same three changes, at the same ticks.

scenes.title: Next
scenes.text: That is Tl. Clip, track, kind, column. The full course is in the read me, at I A Fahim slash tl dot unity.
